tasks.goal: Patrol molecular modeling benches and inspect compound storage racks along the lab floor.
tasks.terrain: Flat sealed lab flooring with bench legs, rolling carts, and cable runs as low obstacles; verify climbs under 15 cm.
success: Visit all 6 marked bench waypoints
Mean localization error < 0.15 m over run
Zero collisions logged via /spot/collision_events
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 1.0 m
Stop if battery < 20%
Halt on unexpected obstacle < 0.3 m ahead
tasks.human_in_loop: Lab supervisor reviews inspection images and approves rack re-scan before docking.

tasks.goal: Escort visitors between seating tiers and the DAO voting terminals during sessions.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted hall floor with tiered steps at edges, chair clusters, and cabling to voting terminals; avoid stairs entirely.
success: Complete 4 escort routes with < 0.2 m path deviation
Keep pace between 0.4-0.8 m/s near seated humans
Post at designated spot within 0.1 m at route end
safety_stops: Stop when a person is within 0.8 m in path
Disable motion during active vote announcements
Stop on tilt > 10 degrees
tasks.human_in_loop: Hall steward approves each escort route while governance session is in progress.

tasks.goal: Lift and carry server drive trays between the ledger racks and maintenance bench with two arms.
tasks.terrain: Raised access floor tiles in server aisle; rack frames and cable trays limit arm clearance to 0.6 m corridors.
success: Complete 3 pick-and-place cycles with grip force within 10% of target
No tray drop events (wrist FT spike > 50 N)
Final placement within 0.03 m of bench target
safety_stops: Release-and-freeze on FT anomaly > 50 N
Stop if any human enters aisle
Kneel-safe posture on power fault
tasks.human_in_loop: Data-center technician approves each tray extraction before robot touches rack hardware.

tasks.goal: Stand at the patient consent kiosk and gesture-guide users through SMS consent prompts.
tasks.terrain: Kiosk plinth edge and floor cables around the desk-height terminal; NAO must remain on flat ground beside the kiosk.
success: Complete 5 scripted consent walkthroughs
Speech-to-intent match > 90% on 10 test phrases
No falls; base tilt < 5 degrees throughout
safety_stops: Pause interaction if user steps back > 1.5 m
Sit-down safe pose on low battery
Stop arm motion if touch sensor pressed firmly
tasks.human_in_loop: Nurse confirms patient identity and authorizes kiosk session start; NAO never collects consent itself.

tasks.goal: Sort labeled agent-task bins on the hub conveyor into R&D and Clinical Support chutes.
tasks.terrain: Fixed pedestal beside conveyor; bin edges and divider guards constrain reach; no locomotion, workcell only.
success: Sort 20 bins with > 95% correct chute assignment
Cycle time < 8 s per bin
Zero gripper faults over run
safety_stops: Joint stop if wrench exceeds 40 N
Halt if human enters workcell zone
Stop conveyor interface on vision loss > 2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Hub operator approves bin-to-chute mapping table before each shift.

tasks.goal: Survey the exterior ledger facility perimeter including bay-side mudflat access road.
tasks.terrain: Compacted gravel and bay mudflats near San Francisco Bay shoreline; soft mud, tidal slough edges, and drainage culverts.
success: Complete 1.2 km perimeter loop
Stay on gravel within 0.5 m of planned path
Log terrain slip estimate < 0.3 throughout
safety_stops: Return if GPS accuracy degrades > 3 m
Halt 5 m from slough waterline
Stop if wheel slip > 0.5 for 3 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Facility manager approves survey window around tide schedule before launch.

tasks.goal: Fly a 3-D scan of rack-top LED status arrays and thermal hotspots inside the ledger hall.
tasks.terrain: Ceiling clearance 6 m; rack tops, cable trays, and overhead lighting as aerial obstacles; mild bay-side draft at door.
success: Capture 4 rack rows at 1 m standoff, coverage > 90%
Maintain position hold within 0.1 m RMS
Land with battery > 15% remaining
safety_stops: Auto-land on battery < 20%
Land if any range sensor reads < 0.3 m
Cut motors on attitude fault or pilot command
tasks.human_in_loop: Flight operator issues takeoff clearance and reviews thermal scan before data is stored.

tasks.goal: Deliver sample trays from cold storage to the molecular modeling benches on schedule.
tasks.terrain: Smooth lab floor with door thresholds ~2 cm, bench overhangs at 0.75 m height, and cold-room drip zones causing slick patches.
success: Deliver 5 trays on time within 60 s tolerance each
Tray level maintained within 3 degrees of horizontal
No slip events on slick-patch zones (logged)
safety_stops: Stop for humans < 1.0 m ahead
Pause delivery if cold-room door closed
Zero-torque arm hold on e-stop
tasks.human_in_loop: Lab manager approves cold-storage withdrawal manifest per delivery batch.
